title: Design data component declaration
description: Layer 1 structural schema for a component declaration. Semantic cross-reference rules (component-name-exists, component-variant-valid, etc.) are Layer 2.

$id.description: Canonical identifier for this component declaration.

name.description: Machine identifier (kebab-case). Must match the value used in token name-object 'component' fields.

description.description: Plain-text description of the component's purpose.

implementations.description: Known platform implementations of this component. Foundation data carries canonical default mappings; a platform manifest refines its own rows through extensions/implementations/. See spec/component-format.md#implementations.

subcomponent.description: True when the component exists only inside another component and has no stand-alone use. The hosts are derived from the anatomy parts and recipes that name it, never stored. See spec/component-format.md#sub-components.

constraints.description: Rules restricting which option value combinations are valid. See spec/option-constraints.md.

slots.description: Named content injection points. See spec/component-format.md#slots.

anatomy.description: Named visible parts of the component. Full spec in spec/anatomy-format.md (Phase 6.2).

reviewedIn.description: Version in which the anatomy was last reviewed against the anatomy definition.

anatomyReview.description: Review status of this component's anatomy. Absent means draft. See spec/anatomy-format.md#review-checklist.

states.description: Per-component state declarations. Full spec in spec/state-model.md (Phase 6.3).

documentBlocks.description: Typed prose blocks for this component. See spec/document-blocks.md (Phase 9).

accessibility.description: Semantic accessibility vocabulary for this component. See spec/accessibility.md (Phase 7).

category.description: Category id from @adobe/spectrum-design-data registry/categories.json. Advisory validation via SPEC-034.

documentationUrl.description: URL of the component's documentation page.

platform.description: Target platform identifier (for example, 'web', 'ios', or 'android'). Multiple implementations may target the same platform when they have distinct packages.

implementation.description: Implementation project id from the platform-implementations registry (for example, 'react-spectrum' or 'web-components'). Distinguishes implementations that share a `platform` device target. A platform manifest stamps its own `platform` id here when merging extensions/implementations/ entries that omit it.

componentName.description: Exported class, element, or component name used by the platform implementation.

importPath.description: Importable module or source path for a platform implementation. When `package` is also set, this SHOULD be a subpath export of that package.

package.description: Published package containing the platform implementation.

notes.description: Optional implementation-specific usage or mapping notes.

optionsMap.description: Component API options. Each key is a camelCase option name; each value is an option descriptor.

optionConstraint.description: If-then rule over option values. Layer 1 checks shape only; that names and values are declared in `options` is Layer 2.

when.description: Option conditions (ANDed). A literal matches that value; an array matches any of its values.

require.description: What matching combinations must satisfy: permitted values, or { present } for presence.

optionDescriptor.description: Descriptor for a single component option. The `type` keyword follows JSON Schema conventions. Use `values` (not `enum`) to declare permitted values — the structured array allows per-value lifecycle metadata. Other JSON Schema keywords (default, description, pattern, minimum, maximum, items, properties, $ref) are permitted as needed.
optionDescriptor.$comment: additionalProperties: true is required to allow JSON Schema passthrough keywords (pattern, minimum, etc.). This means the legacy `enum` keyword is silently accepted at Layer 1; SPEC-038 closes the gap at Layer 2 by warning when `enum` is present.

values.description: Exhaustive list of permitted values for this option, each with optional per-value metadata. Use this instead of the JSON Schema `enum` keyword so that lifecycle annotations can be attached to individual values. Consumed by SPEC-019 (variant validation) and SPEC-037 (deprecation cascade).

default.description: Default value when the option is not specified.

description.description: Plain-text description of what the option controls.

$ref.description: Reference to a shared type schema.

optionValue.description: A single permitted value for a component option, with optional per-value metadata.

value.description: The permitted option value. Typically a string; the schema does not constrain the type so booleans and numbers remain expressible.

description.description: Plain-text description of what this value means.

lifecycle.description: Version lifecycle metadata for this value. Set lifecycle.deprecatedIn to signal that tokens referencing this value should migrate (SPEC-037).

name.description: Slot identifier, unique within the component. `default`, or the name of the slot's part (SPEC-104).

description.description: What content belongs in this slot.

part.description: The anatomy part this slot attaches to. Without `collection` it is the part that hosts the slot's content; with `collection` it is the component's own part that repeats, once per entry (its host is its anatomy parent). Must be a declared anatomy part (SPEC-104).

accepts.description: Components that may fill the slot. Component names only; free content is a slot with no `accepts`.

acceptsOnly.description: Only the components in `accepts` may fill the slot. When false, `accepts` is a preferred list. Requires `accepts` (SPEC-104).

min.description: Fewest fills (or collection entries). 1 or more makes the slot required.

max.description: Most fills (or collection entries). Absent means no limit.

collection.description: The array option whose entries are drawn as copies of `part`. Must be a declared array option (SPEC-104).

anatomyPart.description: Named visible part of a component. Full spec in spec/anatomy-format.md (Phase 6.2).

component.description: Another component this part is (for example a progress circle in a button): the part is that component drawn inside this one. Names a declared, non-deprecated component other than the host (SPEC-106). A recipe `component` part reads it from here.

contains.description: Anatomy part names nested within this part. SHOULD reference a `name` declared elsewhere in this component's anatomy array (see anatomy-contains-resolves).

documentBlocks.description: Typed prose blocks for this anatomy part. See spec/document-blocks.md (Phase 9).

lifecycle.description: Version lifecycle metadata for this anatomy part. Set lifecycle.deprecatedIn to signal that tokens referencing this part should migrate.

presentWhen.description: When an anatomy part is present: every listed state is active (all of) and every listed option has one of its values. Absent means the part is present in any configuration. Not for state-dependent styling. See spec/anatomy-format.md (presentWhen).

states.description: Declared component states that must all be active (SPEC-074).

options.description: Declared options and the value each must have; an array lists alternatives (any of). Option names and values are checked by SPEC-074 (as SPEC-064).

stateDeclaration.description: Per-component state declaration. Full spec in spec/state-model.md.

trigger.description: 'prop' for persistent prop-driven states (isDisabled); 'interaction' for runtime states (hover, focus, pressed).

precedence.description: Resolution precedence among active interaction states; higher integer wins. Defaults to the canonical value for the state name, else 0.

layered.description: Deprecated and ignored by resolvers; see the state model.

announce.description: Screen-reader announcement hint for this state transition. See spec/accessibility.md.

communicates.description: Semantic meaning conveyed to AT when this state is active (e.g. 'expanded', 'disabled'). See spec/accessibility.md.

blocksInteraction.description: Whether this state prevents all user interaction. See spec/accessibility.md.

lifecycle.description: Version lifecycle metadata for this state. Set lifecycle.deprecatedIn to signal that tokens referencing this state should migrate.
Version lifecycle metadata, mirroring the token lifecycle pattern.

introduced.description: Spec version when this component declaration was added (e.g. '1.0.0-draft').

deprecatedIn.description: Spec version when this component was deprecated. Truthy = deprecated.

deprecatedComment.description: Human-readable explanation of the deprecation and migration path.

replacedBy.description: name value(s) of the replacement component(s).
